share.title: Export for sharing
share.skippedMedia.one: {count} video or sound is left out (pictures only)
share.skippedMedia.other: {count} videos or sounds are left out (pictures only)
share.noPictures: There are no pictures to export
share.webpLossless: WebP is saved without loss (no quality setting)
share.removeInfoHelp: Leaves out the prompt, settings and workflow. The picture is saved again from its pixels, so no other embedded data remains.
share.keepInfoPngOnly: Only PNG can keep the generation info
share.jpegWhite: JPEG has no transparency, so transparent parts become white
share.backup.createHelp: Puts the gallery (pictures, videos, sounds), boards, workflows, characters, presets, comic projects, the agent's chats and settings into one zip file. Models and the image engine are not included.
share.backup.keysNote: API keys and tokens are encrypted for this PC only, so they are not included. Enter them again after a restore.
share.backup.restoreHelp: Replaces the current data with the backup's and restarts the app.
share.backup.createFailed: The backup could not be created
share.backup.warning: Everything you have now (gallery, boards, workflows and the screen state) is replaced and cannot be brought back. Running jobs stop. Create a backup first if you may need it.
share.backup.mockNote: In the mock, a JSON file without the pictures is downloaded, and a restore stops at the confirmation.
share.backup.mockRestore: Restoring is not available in the mock; use the desktop app
share.watermarkHelp: Adds an invisible watermark (TrustMark), the IPTC label for AI-made media and signed Content Credentials (C2PA).
share.watermarkNote: The watermark sits in the centered square of the picture; cropping, regenerating or heavy edits can remove it. The signature is made on this PC, so other apps show the signer as untrusted.
share.watermarkMissing: The watermark's files are not here yet
share.watermarkFailed: Could not get the watermark's files: {message}
share.doneWatermarked.one: {count} picture carries the watermark and Content Credentials
share.doneWatermarked.other: {count} pictures carry the watermark and Content Credentials
share.check.title: Check for a watermark
share.check.watermarkOther: A TrustMark watermark that is not novira's
share.check.watermarkUnchecked: Not checked: the watermark's files are not ready
share.check.originalDeleted: The picture it was exported from has been deleted from the gallery
share.check.originalUnknown: Not in this app's export records
share.check.credentialsBroken: Present, but the signature does not match (changed or damaged)
share.check.signerThisApp: Signed by novira on this PC
share.check.signerUntrusted: The signer is not on a trust list
share.check.note: The watermark scheme is public: anyone can write the same mark, and it can be removed. Finding nothing does not prove a picture was not made with AI.
